claims.text: The hotel is in the historic centre of Verona, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia.

findings.quote: The Due Torri Hotel is located in the historic centre of Verona, near the Basilica of Saint Anastasia

claims.text: The hotel is a short distance from Juliet's balcony, Piazza Bra and the Verona Arena.

findings.quote: a short distance from Juliet’s balcony, Piazza Bra and the world-famous Verona Arena

claims.text: The hotel is set in a 14th-century residence.
Classic rooms are furnished in Empire style.

findings.quote: Our Classic rooms, furnished in elegant Empire style

claims.text: Grand Deluxe rooms are furnished with original period furniture.

findings.quote: Furnished with original period furniture, the Grand Deluxe rooms

claims.text: The S. Anastasia Presidential Suite looks over Piazza Sant'Anastasia.

findings.quote: The S. Anastasia Presidential Suite, looking over the square of the same name

claims.text: Bistrot al 2 has a dedicated entrance and welcomes non-residents.

findings.quote: Thanks to a dedicated entrance, Bistrot al 2 is more open than ever to the city, also welcoming non-residents

claims.text: The Due Torri Bar is on the piano nobile, with frescoes on its walls.

findings.quote: Located on the piano nobile, the bar hosts guests in a refined and relaxing atmosphere, enhanced by the frescoes adorning the walls

claims.text: The hotel offers six tours to discover Verona's history, culture and artistic attractions.

findings.quote: Six tours to discover Verona’s history, culture and artistic attractions

claims.text: The hotel is a member of The Leading Hotels of the World.

findings.quote: We at the Hotel Due Torri, as members of The Leading Hotels of the World

claims.text: Mozart stayed at the Due Torri Hotel in 1777, and the Mozart Deluxe Suite is dedicated to him.

findings.quote: The Mozart Deluxe Suite is dedicated to the great composer who stayed at the Due Torri Hotel in 1777

claims.text: Bistrot al 2 is in the Sala dell'Aquila, designed personally by chef Gualtiero Marchesi.

findings.quote: It is located in the Sala dell’Aquila, designed personally by Gualtiero Marchesi, the famous Italian chef

claims.text: The Rooftop Gourmet Grill Restaurant sits around 30 metres above the ground, a short distance from Saint Anastasia.

findings.quote: Three hundred square metres suspended around 30 metres from the ground, a short distance away from Saint Anastasia.

claims.text: The breakfast room walls are adorned with frescoes depicting locations in Verona.

findings.quote: the frescoes which adorn the walls: images preserved in time, capable of skilfully recounting some of the most beautiful and iconic locations in Verona

findings.quote: a visit in the backstage and technical areas to meet stagehands, tailors, and property staff

claims.text: The panoramic terrace with grill restaurant is available in the warmer months.

findings.quote: In the warmer months, the splendid Terrazza Panoramica con Grill Restaurant is also available
